name: remix-v3-upgrade
description: Upgrade a Remix 3.x project (3.0.0 stable and later) to a newer 3.x release, written for apps derived from kuboon/deno-remix-tmpl and the @remix-kbn/* packages: where the real changelogs live (npm tarballs ship none), the lockfile check for a second @remix-run/component, @remix-run/ui sitting outside the remix meta-package's pinned set, keeping custom data-table adapters in step with the driver contract, and per-release notes from 3.3.0 on (data-table 1.1.0 changing how json/boolean/timestamp values are written and read, Turso timestamp rows that need converting, form edits replayed at hydration).
